lots.title: Inspection & Maintenance of Indoor Gymnasium, Fitness & Sport Equipment and Outdoor Schools Play & Sport Equipment (ESPO Framework 107_26)
lots.description: Single-lot ESPO framework (reference 107_26) covering inspection, maintenance and remedial work on indoor gymnasium, fitness & sport equipment and on outdoor schools play & sport equipment. Framework period runs 24 June 2026 – 31 January 2028 with an option to extend to 23 June 2030. The supplied document is the Tender Submission Document (response template); the detailed specification, technical standards and full evaluation methodology are externally incorporated from Framework Schedule 1 (Specification) and Section 2/5 of the Invitation to Tender, which are not included in this Docling payload.
requirements: Supplier must confirm compliance with all essential elements of the requirement and specification as set out in Section 2 of the Invitation to Tender (Requirement including Specification).
Mandatory geographical coverage: Supplier must be able to provide Goods and/or Services to the nine defined regions of England.

Optional geographical coverage: Supplier asked to indicate ability to supply to Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland so the Framework may be extended to eligible public sector bodies in those nations.
Supplier must submit a complete Pricing Schedule (Appendix B) with prices for each service requirement; failure to complete the Pricing Schedule in full may result in rejection of the Tender.
Tendered pricing populates the Framework pricing, from which Customers call off; earliest adjustment date for pricing increases is governed by Framework Schedule 2 (Charging Structure).
Supplier must allow for ESPO Framework Fees in the submitted Tender (clause 16 of the Framework Agreement terms and conditions).

Supplier must complete six method statements (five quality-based plus Social Value); each quality-based method statement has a maximum word limit of 700 words and the Social Value method statement has a maximum word limit of 500 words.
Supplier must describe how it will record and supply required management information (MI) to ESPO, including identifying customers using the framework.

Supplier must describe its site-visit, inspection, maintenance and remedial-work processes, including technical support, decommissioning/reinstatement, enquiry-response monitoring and lessons-learned loops.
Supplier must describe how it maintains equipment to a high safety and quality standard while minimising costs.

Supplier must complete the Social Value Percentage table (information-only) showing Social Value % offered across five Customer Contract Value Bands (£0.01–£50,000, £50,001–£100,000, £100,001–£200,000, £200,001–£400,000, £400,001+).
Supplier must indicate any prompt-payment discount terms offered for settlement within 7, 14 or 21 days from receipt of invoice (standard settlement is 30 days).

Supplier must complete the Confidential Information Schedule identifying any items considered commercially sensitive under FOIA/EIR and the Procurement Act 2023, together with reasons and a confidentiality expiry date.

Supplier must sign the Tendering Declaration (clauses 1–16), including: registration on the Central Digital Platform; non-collusion undertakings; a 120-day offer validity; acceptance of the Framework Agreement terms; and compliance with the Framework Fee provision.
Closing date for submission of tenders: 12 noon, 15 May 2026; submission must be uploaded to the www.eastmidstenders.org eProcurement Portal.
Tender Submission Document must be signed by a director, partner or other senior authorised representative on behalf of the organisation and include signatory name, job title, email and telephone.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Method Statement Q1 — Customer Engagement and Framework Management
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe engagement with current and prospective Customers, attraction and retention of Customers across the Framework, framework management (monitoring enquiries, resources, capacity) and the supply of required management information (MI) including identifying ESPO framework customers.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Method Statement Q2 — Customer Site Visit Process
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe the process for making inspection, maintenance and remedial appointments, arrival and delivery of service at customer sites, and specific previous examples.
Provide an example completed inspection & maintenance report; outline key features, customer benefits and added value, and how consistency of reporting is ensured across different staff members.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Method Statement Q4 — Services following completion of work
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe post-inspection and post-maintenance services (technical support, remedial works, equipment decommissioning and reinstatement), enquiry-response monitoring and lessons-learned loops, with previous examples.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Method Statement Q5 — Consistency of Standards
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe how high safety and quality standards are maintained during inspections, maintenance and remedial work, and how costs are minimised, with previously evidenced examples.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Method Statement Q6 — Organisation's Current Approach to Social Value
evaluation_criteria.summary: Describe the organisation's understanding of Social Value, any current or planned schemes/policies that benefit the economic, social and environmental well-being of the UK areas in which the organisation operates, and the processes used to measure effectiveness. Maximum word limit 500 (other method statements 700).
